questions.stem: Regarding Alternative text: a designer reviewing a community theater's playbill notices that meaningful images on a page have no text description at all. What is the primary problem this creates?

options.text: The page will necessarily load much more slowly as a result

options.text: Screen-reader users cannot access the information in the images

questions.hint: How does a non-visual user learn what a particular image shows?
